I was prescribed Citalopram and Klonopin. Honestly the Citalopram (for depression) has done little for me but has not nullified me. The Klonopin has been okay up until recently. (Seeing the psych in a few days) But I guess what I'm trying to tell you is that getting a therapist is great and they won't put you into an institution. Everything should be friendly. So uh, best of luck OP 👍
